user.title: HouseLit
user.description:
This turns on HouseLit. Next, open **HouseLit** in the sidebar and choose **Pair a device** on the Home tab. With the iPhone app, choose **Show a QR code**. On a watch without an iPhone, choose **Pair with Home Assistant** on the watch, then type the code it shows under **Type a code**. On HouseLit 3.0, which has no pairing, sign in to Home Assistant from the iPhone app instead.

[Setup guide]({docs_url})

abort.single_instance_allowed: HouseLit is already set up. To add a device, open HouseLit in the sidebar and choose Pair a device.
